newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar closes weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar closes weaker but off lows.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures climbed back from session lows set early to close a thinly traded session barely weaker, with March at the day's high.

Analysts said the ability of the contract to hold above the 40-day moving average of 10.63 cents a lb and close just under Tuesday's high of 10.71 bodes well for the market. But the contract must pierce Tuesday's high in order to entend the recent rally, they added.
Resistance was pegged at 10.73 while support was seen at a gap on the charts between 10.48 and 10.50 for March sugar.

Some traders said prices are likely to trade sideways before falling toward support, since there is still no significant amount of physical offtake to justify higher prices. Estimates for world crops continue to show that supplies will be more than adequate to meet demand.
March settled 0.01 easier at 10.68, traded 10.68 to 10.59. The back months finished 0.03 firmer to 0.02 weaker.
